Q: How do I set up the IMPINJ Scanner?

A: **Step 1 — Download the app.** Open the **App Store** on your phone and download **RFID Explorer**.

---

<!-- Step 2: Pair via Bluetooth -->
<p align="center">
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" width="200" height="200" viewBox="0 0 800 800">
  <image href="data:image/jpeg;base64," width="800" height="800"/>
  <!-- Red circle highlighting the label on top of scanner -->
  <ellipse cx="480" cy="160" rx="160" ry="50" fill="none" stroke="#e74c3c" stroke-width="8" stroke-dasharray="12,6"/>

</svg>
</p>

Q: How do I connect the scanner to my phone?

A: **Step 2 — Pair via Bluetooth.** Press the **yellow trigger** on the IMPINJ scanner once. A **blue light** will appear indicating Bluetooth search mode. Then go to **Settings > Bluetooth** on your phone and select the scanner that appears as the numbers found on the scanner label (example **003114-US-1128**).

Q: What do I do after connecting?

A: **Step 3 — Open RFID Explorer** and select **Inventory**.

Q: What power setting should I use?

A: **Max power (29 dBm).** ⚠️ At max power the reader will pick up **any and all tags nearby** — make sure you have isolated what you are scanning at a distance.

Q: How do I scan?

A: **Hold down the yellow trigger.** EPC codes will start appearing in the app. Keep holding until all items are scanned.

Q: How do I export the scan results?

A: **Press the export button** (top-right of Inventory screen. Three dots). A confirmation page will show the CSV list. **Press the export symbol again** at the top-right corner to save/share the file.
